name: Athlone (TUS Athlone campus)
image_credit: Olliebailie, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
environment: Temperate river town on glacial deposits over limestone
summary: Athlone sits on the Shannon in the flat Irish midlands, so it matches low relief and gentle slopes well. Its mild, wet, green climate is the opposite of the Moon and Mars.
planetary_connection: The landscape here was shaped by the last ice sheet: eskers, drumlins and glacial sediments lie across the midlands, and ice-sheet landforms are studied on Mars. Nearby raised bogs also make acidic, oxygen-poor water chemistry that is used to think about wet, acidic environments.
weak_points: Humid, vegetated, very low relief and mild all year; far from the cold, dry, bare ground of the Moon and Mars. Included on purpose as local data, with honest scores.

name: Clonmacnoise on the Esker Riada
image_credit: Ingo Mehling, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
summary: The Esker Riada is a long ridge of sand and gravel left by meltwater under an ice sheet, and Clonmacnoise stands on it where it meets the Shannon. Mars has eskers too, but this one is green and mild.
planetary_connection: Eskers are made by rivers that flowed inside or under glaciers. Eskers have been mapped on Mars in the Dorsa Argentea region and near Argyre, where they are read as signs of past glacial meltwater. The Irish esker is a close shape and process match, in a very different climate.
weak_points: Temperate, wet and vegetated, with a gentle climate and liquid water on the surface; Earth air and life shape the landscape today.

name: Burren (Poulnabrone)
summary: The Burren is a bare, glaciated limestone plateau full of fissures, caves and underground streams. It is one of the best places in Europe to see how rock dissolves into voids.
planetary_connection: Karst shows how water carves voids and caves underground, a process analog for subsurface space and dissolution. The Moon has no limestone and Mars's best-known cave candidates are lava tubes and skylights, not limestone caves, so the match is about process and exploration of underground space, not about rock type.
weak_points: Mild, wet, windy Atlantic climate with grass and wild flowers in the cracks; the rock is carbonate, which the Moon lacks and Mars shows only in small amounts.
